items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was thinking about when Pete was with Lawrence Welk... [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: I was thinking about when Pete was with Lawrence Welk. A lady next door used to say to me to come in on Saturday night, and we would sit with her husband and watch the Lawrence Welk show. It was such a clean show that I didn't mind watching it. And the one tickle me, Pete said he had to come back to New Orleans to get his red beans and rice.
